query: How do I enable an XDM schema for Real-Time Customer Profile?

results.title: Enable a schema for use in Real-Time Customer Profile
results.content: To enable a schema for Profile, the schema must have a primary identity field defined. In the Schema Editor, select the schema, then toggle 'Profile' in the schema properties panel and confirm. Via the API, PATCH the schema with {"op": "add", "path": "/meta:immutableTags", "value": ["union"]}. Once enabled for Profile, a schema cannot be disabled and fields can only be added, not removed.

results.title: Union schemas
results.content: Every schema enabled for Profile contributes its fields to the union schema for its class.
